result.description:
Retail Manager–  Northcote

About Us

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters,  is working  is a growing retail food business specialising in Korean-style fried chicken who are seeking their new Retail Manager. The business operates through takeaway, customer pickups and third-party delivery platforms, supported by state of the art integrated retail technology and digital ordering systems.

As part of their long-term growth strategy, our client is investing in scalable retail systems, operational consistency and commercial processes to support future expansion across multiple locations.

•	Location: Northcote, VIC

•	Employment Type: Full-time, ongoing

•	Salary: Negotiable in the range $80,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Retail Manager to oversee the commercial and operational management of our retail business. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving business performance, managing staff, coordinating inventory and purchasing activities, maintaining compliance with company policies, and implementing operational systems that improve efficiency and support business growth.

The role requires a commercially focused manager with strong leadership, financial administration and business systems experience who can optimise retail operations across multiple sites while ensuring high standards of customer service and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the day-to-day operation of the retail business to achieve sales, profitability and customer service objectives. 

•	Develop and implement business strategies to improve operational efficiency, sales performance and overall profitability. 

•	Monitor sales performance, analyse trading results and prepare operational and financial reports for management. 

•	Manage retail budgets, expenses and cost control initiatives while supporting pricing and promotional strategies. 

•	Coordinate inventory management, purchasing activities and supplier relationships to ensure product availability and minimise stock losses.
 
•	Monitor stock movement and inventory records, ensuring accurate stock control and reconciliation procedures. 

•	Recruit, supervise, train and performance manage employees, including workforce planning, rostering and payroll administration using workforce management systems. 

•	Develop, implement and maintain operational procedures, policies and staff training programs to ensure consistent business practices. 

•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, food retail regulations, company policies and other statutory obligations. 

•	Manage customer service standards, respond to customer enquiries and resolve complaints to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.
 
•	Coordinate the implementation and ongoing improvement of retail technology, point-of-sale systems and operational software to enhance business performance. 

•	Identify opportunities to improve business processes and support the development of systems suitable for future multi-site operations. 

Skills & Experience Required to be considered

•	Diploma or higher in Business, Management, Commerce or a closely related discipline or agreed substitute

•	At least one or more years of experience,  managing retail operations, preferably within a high-volume retail or food retail environment. 

•	Demonstrated experience in financial administration, budgeting, reporting and cost management. 

•	Experience managing inventory systems, purchasing processes and supplier relationships. 

•	Strong knowledge of retail workforce planning, payroll administration and employee supervision. 

•	Experience implementing and maintaining retail operating procedures and business systems. 

•	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and regulatory compliance. 

•	Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with the ability to make commercial decisions. 

•	Excellent leadership, communication and customer service skills. 

•	Experience using retail management software, point-of-sale systems and workforce management platforms such as Deputy is highly desirable. 

•	Valid unrestricted Victorian drivers license

You must have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to apply for this position. 

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing retail business focused on innovation, operational excellence and future expansion. You will play a key role in developing scalable retail systems, improving commercial performance and supporting the continued growth of the business.

Applications

result.description:
IT Systems Analyst
Full-time
Glow Health Care Australia Pty Ltd trading as Glow Health Care Australia
Parramatta, NSW
Salary: $80,000–$100,000 plus superannuation
About the Role
Glow Health Care Australia is seeking an experienced IT Systems Analyst to support and improve the technology systems used across our disability, aged care, home care, allied health and NDIS service operations.
In this role, you will work with managers, employees, external vendors and technology teams to identify business needs, analyse existing systems and implement practical technology solutions. You will help ensure our systems are secure, reliable, compliant and aligned with the organisation’s operational requirements.
Duties and Responsibilities
•	Analyse existing systems, applications and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. 
•	Consult with stakeholders to gather and document functional and technical requirements. 
•	Translate business requirements into system designs and technical specifications. 
•	Prepare system workflows, process maps, data mappings and functional documentation. 
•	Recommend system enhancements, new applications and improvements to existing platforms. 
•	Coordinate the implementation and rollout of new systems and system upgrades. 
•	Develop and conduct system, integration and user acceptance testing. 
•	Investigate system defects and coordinate resolutions with vendors and development teams. 
•	Support the integration of third-party applications with internal systems and platforms. 
•	Monitor system interfaces and data flows to maintain accuracy and interoperability. 
•	Prepare user guides, technical procedures, training materials and system documentation. 
•	Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for complex system-related issues. 
•	Assist with staff training and change-management activities during system implementations. 
•	Ensure systems comply with privacy, cybersecurity, data-governance and healthcare requirements. 
•	Conduct post-implementation reviews and recommend further system improvements. 
Skills and Qualifications
•	Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
•	At least two to three years of relevant experience as a Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or in a similar ICT position. 
•	Experience analysing, implementing and supporting organisational or enterprise systems. 
•	Strong knowledge of requirements gathering, process mapping and technical documentation. 
•	Experience with system integration, APIs, databases and data modelling. 
•	Experience conducting integration testing and user acceptance testing. 
•	Familiarity with SQL, Visio, Jira, Confluence or similar tools. 
•	Understanding of Agile, Waterfall or other software-development methodologies. 
•	Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
•	Knowledge of information security, privacy and data-governance principles. 
•	Experience in healthcare, disability, aged care, community services or NDIS operations is desirable. 
•	ITIL, CBAP, PRINCE2 or similar certification would be advantageous. 
How to Apply
Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience.
Glow Health Care Australia is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven ICT Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects across our organisation. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership capabilities, a solid understanding of ICT systems and infrastructure, and a proven ability to manage competing priorities within budget and timeline constraints. This role suits a results-oriented professional who thrives in dynamic environments and can effectively bridge technical and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Plan, organise, and oversee end-to-end delivery of ICT projects, ensuring milestones, objectives, and deliverables are met within agreed timeframes and budgets
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to address those requirements effectively
Formulate and contribute to ICT strategies, policies, and plans that align with broader business goals and digital transformation initiatives
Direct the selection, procurement, and installation of ICT resources, including software, hardware, and infrastructure, and coordinate relevant user training programmes
Manage project resources, scheduling, and task prioritisation, allocating team members and contractors to maximise efficiency and project outcomes
Set priorities across system development, maintenance, and operational activities, balancing short-term demands with long-term strategic objectives
Oversee the security and integrity of ICT systems, ensuring compliance with organisational policies, data governance frameworks, and relevant legislative requirements
Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies and escalating where necessary to ensure continuity of delivery
Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk registers, and post-implementation reviews
Liaise with internal stakeholders, vendors, and third-party service providers to manage expectations, resolve impediments, and maintain clear lines of communication throughout the project lifecycle
Monitor project budgets, track expenditure, and provide regular financial reporting to senior leadership and governance committees
Champion continuous improvement by conducting lessons-learnt reviews and embedding better practices across the project delivery function
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience (typically 3–5 years) managing ICT projects of varying scale and complexity within a corporate or government environment
Proficiency in project management methodologies such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum frameworks
Strong understanding of ICT infrastructure, software development lifecycles, systems integration, and enterprise technology environments
Proven ability to manage budgets, resource plans, and project schedules using tools such as MS Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management
Experience preparing and presenting project governance documentation, business cases, and status reports to senior leadership
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage vendor relationships effectively
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, data privacy obligations, and relevant Australian regulatory frameworks
Preferred Qualifications
PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned service environments
Experience delivering projects within Agile or hybrid delivery models
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience in change management practices and supporting organisational technology transitions
Exposure to enterprise resource planning (ERP) or large-scale system implementation projects
Prior experience working within highly regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
Why Join Us?
Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote options, supporting a healthy work-life balance
Ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications, training programmes, and industry conference access
A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values innovation, continuous improvement, and diverse perspectives
Access to an employee benefits programme including wellness initiatives, additional leave options, and corporate discounts
Meaningful work contributing to impactful technology projects that drive real organisational and community outcomes
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
